module_role: Reconciles every M-401 schedule identity to plan/detail/source context without turning schematic appearances or embedded humidifier cabinet text into extra equipment counts. The supplied set has no dedicated control-valve or damper-actuator schedule.

primary_anchors.visual_anchor: M-102 new-work roof plan labels AHU-04; M-201 Detail 1 caption uses AHU-4.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels AHU-05; M-201 Detail 1 caption uses AHU-5.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels AHU-06; M-201 Detail 2 caption uses AHU-6.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels AHU-07; M-201 Detail 3 caption uses AHU-7.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels AHU-08; M-201 Detail 1 caption uses AHU-8.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels CH-2; M-103 phasing plan specifies temporary air-cooled chiller service while the cooling tower is replaced.
M-102 new-work roof plan labels CT-1; M-103 phasing requires remove/replace existing cooling tower.
M-401 duct-size cell prints (IN AHU-4 CABINET); this embeds the humidifier in the associated AHU cabinet but is not a plan count.
M-401 duct-size cell prints (IN AHU-5 CABINET); this embeds the humidifier in the associated AHU cabinet but is not a plan count.
M-401 duct-size cell prints (IN AHU-6 CABINET); this embeds the humidifier in the associated AHU cabinet but is not a plan count.
M-401 duct-size cell prints (IN AHU-8 CABINET); this embeds the humidifier in the associated AHU cabinet but is not a plan count.

plan_and_detail_reconciliation.finding: The full-page plan visually anchors AHU-04 through AHU-08, CH-2 and CT-1 to planned work. It does not present a controls point matrix.
Controls captions omit zero-padding on AHU marks: AHU-4/5/8, AHU-6 and AHU-7. The record preserves source forms rather than silently rewriting them.
HF-4, HF-5, HF-6 and HF-8 have printed in-AHU-cabinet cells. The four schedule rows are four identities; cabinet wording is not a separate physical-device multiplier.

control_valve_schedule.note: M-201/M-301 show individual existing three-way-valve context and M-401 says cooling coils reconnect to existing 3-way control valves, but the supplied pages contain no control-valve schedule.

damper_actuator_schedule.note: M-201 includes DM-1/DM-2 schematic labels and typed bubble context, but the supplied pages contain no damper-actuator schedule.

source_conflicts.finding: M-401 prints AHU-04/AHU-05/AHU-06/AHU-07/AHU-08; M-201 captions print AHU-4/AHU-5/AHU-6/AHU-7/AHU-8. This is a source-format difference, not an asserted data correction.
